verdict.rationale: Warp is an HR/payroll product, and it documents an onboarding capability of its own: Warp Agent 'takes onboarding', and the API supports creating and sending candidate offers. It also stores worker bank accounts, so bank details are part of the worker record. Nothing shows a self-serve new-hire flow sent before day one, or collection of W-4 and I-9 forms. Missing for 10: an explicit self-serve new-hire onboarding flow sent before the start date, W-4 collection, I-9 collection/verification, an employee-facing bank-detail entry step, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
